race.comment: CELIBATE (3) resumes. She was mixing her form last time in but was largely contesting stronger races in handy 3yo company. She boasts a win and a second here on her home deck and should be sharp enough to go well at 1200m in what looks a fairly winnable race. ARTISTIC GENIUS (1) is coming off a good win here on heavy ground, coming from just off the pace to score decisively. He can take up a handy spot here and go on with the job. WORLD ACTION (13) ran well fresh off a short break here over 1000m when third and should be better for it up in trip, consider. SINGLES MOMENT (4) went to the paddock a maiden winner over this route and is worth respect.
